title: Dan Talks About Recess
recap: A kid laughed at Dan at recess.

slides.text: Dan tried to join a group of kids during recess.
They were near the basketball court.
One kid laughed when Dan paused before answering.
Dan told his mom what happened after school.
His mom listened and said they would talk to his teacher together.
